story.iWant: to access my previous transcriptions and generated posts
story.soThat: I can reuse content or generate new variations
story.tasks: - Task 1: Define cache data structure (AC: 4, 5, 10) - Task 2: Create cache service in main process (AC: 4, 5, 10) - Task 3: Add IPC handlers for cache operations (AC: 4, 5, 8) - Task 4: Auto-save cache after generation (AC: 4, 5) - Task 5: Create History Panel component (AC: 1, 2, 9) - Task 6: Load cache on History tab activation (AC: 1, 4, 5) - Task 7: Implement history entry click handler (AC: 3) - Task 8: Add "Clear Cache" button (AC: 6, 7, 8) - Task 9: Add cache state to aiStore (AC: 4, 5) - Task 10: Implement cache file management (AC: 10) - Task 11-12: Add UI enhancements (empty state, search/filter) - Task 13-15: Write tests for cache service, History Panel, integration (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. History tab displays chronological list of past generations 2. Each history entry shows: timestamp, transcription snippet, generated platforms 3. Clicking history entry loads that transcription and posts into respective tabs 4. Transcriptions cached in project data (persists across sessions) 5. Generated posts cached in project data (persists across sessions) 6. "Clear Cache" button at top of History tab 7. Clear Cache shows confirmation dialog before deleting 8. Clearing cache removes all transcriptions and posts from storage 9. History list scrollable if content exceeds visible area 10. Cache stored efficiently (JSON format, reasonable file size limits)

docs.doc: Defines cache.service.ts for JSON file management in userData directory and HistoryPanel.tsx for history display.
Defines CacheEntry interface with transcription, generatedPosts, request, and timestamps.

artifact.reason: IPC handler location for cache operations

package.name: lucide-react
package.reason: Icons for history entries and buttons

story-context.constraints: - Cache Storage: JSON file in app.getPath('userData')/ai-cache.json for cross-session persistence - Data Structure: CacheEntry with id (UUID), transcription, generatedPosts, request, createdAt timestamp - IPC Communication: Main process handles file I/O, renderer requests via ai-load-cache, ai-save-cache-entry, ai-clear-cache - File Size Limits: Max 10MB or 100 entries, FIFO removal if exceeded - Auto-save: Create and save CacheEntry after successful generation - History Display: Chronological list (newest first), clickable entries load into tabs - Clear Cache: Confirmation dialog (AlertDialog) before deletion
story-context.interfaces:
Defines cache entry structure with all generation data
<interface name="IPC: ai-load-cache" kind="ipc-channel" signature="() => Promise<IPCResponse>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Loads all cache entries from userData directory
<interface name="IPC: ai-save-cache-entry" kind="ipc-channel" signature="(entry: CacheEntry) => Promise<IPCResponse<{success: boolean}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Appends new cache entry to file
<interface name="IPC: ai-clear-cache" kind="ipc-channel" signature="() => Promise<IPCResponse<{success: boolean}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Deletes all cache entries
In-memory cache entries for history display

tests.standards: Unit tests for cache service (save, load, clear, corrupted file handling). Component tests for HistoryPanel (render entries, click handler, clear cache). Integration tests for cache persistence across sessions.
tests.ideas: - AC 1, 2: Test HistoryPanel renders chronological list with timestamp, snippet, platforms - AC 3: Test clicking entry loads transcription/posts into tabs - AC 4, 5: Test cache persistence (save → load across sessions) - AC 6, 7, 8: Test "Clear Cache" button with confirmation dialog - AC 9: Test scrollable list with many entries - AC 10: Test file size limits, FIFO removal, JSON format - Integration: Test complete flow (generate → save cache → load → display → click → clear)
